Overview

An all-new model of the Toyota Camry made its debut in 2018 in the GCC. The 2024 Toyota Camry has three engine choices - a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic transmission, a 3.5-litre V6 coupled to an 8-speed automatic transmission and a 2.5-litre hybrid engine connected to a CVT. The 2024 Toyota Camry base model has 16-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 17-inch and 18-inch alloys. Base features, depending on the market, include a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags, as standard. The upper trims offer dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, stability control, side airbags, sunroof, DVD navigation, smart keyless start and navigation. Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a 2024 Toyota Camry cost in UAE?

The base price of the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE starts from AED 111,900 and goes all the way up to AED 143,000 for the highest trim.

What is the starting price of a 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The starting price of the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE is AED 111,900.

How much is the top-spec 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The highest trim of the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE is the 2.5H I4 Limited FWD and it costs AED 143,000.

What trims are available for the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE is available in 4 trims. The trims are 2.5L I4 SE FWD, 3.5L V6 40th Anniversary FWD, 3.5L V6 Sport FWD, and 2.5H I4 Limited FWD.

What are the engine options for the 2024 Toyota Camry?

The engine choices for the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE are 2.5 I4 FWD, 3.5 V6 FWD, and 2.5 H I4 FWD.

What is the fuel efficiency (mileage) of the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE delivers fuel economy of 13.5 km/l for the 2.5 I4 FWD, 12.8 km/l for the 3.5 V6 FWD, and 25.6 km/l for the 2.5 H I4 FWD.

How reliable is the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The reliability of the 2024 Toyota Camry is rated 5 out of 5 stars in UAE.

What is the resale value of the 2024 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The resale value of the 2024 Toyota Camry is rated 5 out of 5 stars in UAE.
